wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2020–21 |team=UC Santa Barbara Gauchos |image=UC Santa Barbara Gauchos wordmark.svg |image_size=200 |conference=Big West Conference |division= |short_conf=Big West |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=22–5 |conf_record=13–3 |head_coach=[[Joe Pasternack]] |hc_year=4th |assoc_coach=[[John Rillie]] |asst_coach1=Larry Lewis |asst_coach2=Ben Tucker |stadium=[[UC Santa Barbara Events Center|The Thunderdome]] |champion= Big West regular season and [[2021 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|tournament]] champions |bowl= [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], first round |bowl_result= }} {{2020–21 Big West men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 UC Santa Barbara Gauchos men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of California, Santa Barbara]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Gauchos, led by fourth-year head coach [[Joe Pasternack]], play their home games at [[UC Santa Barbara Events Center|The Thunderdome]] in [[Santa Barbara, California]] as members of the [[Big West Conference]]. They finished the season 22–5, 13–3 in [[2020–21 Big West Conference men's basketball season|Big West Play]] to finish as regular season champions. They defeated [[2020–21 Long Beach State Beach men's basketball team|Long Beach State]], [[2020–21 UC Davis Aggies men's basketball team|UC Davis]], and [[2020–21 UC Irvine Anteaters men's basketball team|UC Irvine]] to be champions of the [[2021 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|Big West tournament]]. They received the Big West’s automatic bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2020–21 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 UC Santa Barbara Gauchos men's basketball team|Gauchos]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 21–10, 10–6 in Big West play to finish in a tie for second place. They were scheduled to play [[2019–20 UC Riverside Highlanders men's basketball team|UC Riverside]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2020 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|Big West tournament]], however, the tournament was canceled due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{Cite news|url=https://bigwest.org/news/2020/3/12/mens-basketball-big-west-basketball-tournament-cancelled.aspx|title=Big West Basketball Tournament Cancelled|work=Big West Conference|date=March 12, 2020|accessdate=December 26, 2020|language=en}} == Roster == {{CBB roster/Header|year=2020|team=UC Santa Barbara Gauchos|teamcolors=y|high_school=yes}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Sékou|last=Touré|num=0|pos=G|ft=6|in=5|lbs=185|class=jr|rs=|home=[[Conakry]], [[Guinea]]|high_school=Prolific Prep Academy}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Jay|last=Nagle|num=1|pos=F|ft=6|in=8|lbs=215|class=jr|rs=|home=[[Vacaville, California]]|high_school=[[Will C.
